data.name: Nexorion
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Nexorion! A vast, pixelated universe where your creativity knows no bounds awaits! Build your own world from scratch, embark on adventures with friends, and claim your place in Nexorion's player-driven economy!

Create and Shape Your Own Worlds Use hundreds of blocks with unique properties to build the castle of your dreams, a complex dungeon, or a peaceful farm. Lock your world to make it private for friends, or open it to everyone and create a popular social hub.

In-Depth Crafting and Farming System Discover new and rarer plants by splicing two different seeds together! Use the materials you gather to craft powerful tools, stylish outfits, and unique decorative items. Our crafting system is based on the constant discovery of new recipes.

A Living Economy, Run by Players In Nexorion, nearly everything is crafted and sold by players. Sell your goods in the marketplace, trade with others to find the rarest items, and become wealthy through your trading skills. Here, the economy is entirely in your hands!

Play Together Team up with friends to build massive projects, form guilds to challenge other groups, or just hang out and chat. Nexorion is a game built on community.

data.short_description: Welcome to Nexorion. Write your own story in this 2D sandbox RPG where everything is shaped by crafting, farming, exploration, and trade. Nexorion is a dynamic universe that allows players to express their creativity and build their own adventures in a limitless virtual world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core processor or better (e.g., Intel Core i3 2100)
  • Memory: 200 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 4000) or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: A 64-bit operating system is recommended for better performance.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz quad-core processor or better (e.g., Intel Core i5 2500K)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated graphics card (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GT 730)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: A 64-bit operating system is recommended for better performance.
